title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: admins create custom MCP connectors in the admin centre
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates the protection provided by user approval for write actions, because users can allow subsequent calls without confirmation. It also requires authentication registration for No Auth, which Microsoft documents as needing no setup. The roadmap facts, licensing and principal admin controls are supported.
